name: Terminal
domReason: Light DOM retains static content, native semantics, label relationships and host composition without duplicating controls.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disable the native controls owned by this instance.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Mark the primary control busy and prevent duplicate activation.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Delegates disabled state to native children.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Native control name; application form keys remain explicit.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reconnect behavior after replacing native child structure.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the first usable native control.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Replace the bounded read-only text view; no code or shell execution occurs.

events.name: j3w1-action
events.description: Request a developer-view action; editing and execution belong to the host.

variants.name: Transcript
variants.description: An agnoster-style prompt, an ls listing coloured by the slots that pass the text floor, an ESC[31m-style error line and the cursor.

variants.name: ANSI grid
variants.description: One row per slot, labelled with its number; slots that pass 4.5:1 show sample text, slots that fail show colour blocks and a ✕, and every background is a block.

variants.name: Attributes
variants.description: Bold, dim, italic, underline, inverse and strikethrough.
